result:
I ran every query below against its input file, and each gave a sensible result.

I checked T1, T11 and T12–T14 by hand. T1 gives 4: alice, dave, erin and ivan. The shipped revenue in T12 is 25 + 59.97 + 39.98 + 79.96 = 204.91. Birch totals 109.97 and Acme 104.96 in T13. I did not run T1 again with the missing-email guard (`at :email`), which is in the query below. In this data every user has an `email` key, so it should give the same count.

- **T10:** it prints its keys as keywords (`:db`) in raw mode, not as strings.
- **T14:** it gives `elderberry-banana-cherry-apple-date-kiwi-fig`.

T1: /data/users | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :email | ne null) | filter ~(/email | lower | endsWith "@example.com") | count
T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | map ~(lower) | contains "admin") | sort ~(/name | lower) | map ~(/name)
T3: /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | at :country | coalesce "unknown") | map ~(count)
T4: /data/users | map ~(at :profile | at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2
T5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | map ~(/labels) | flat | map ~(/name | lower) | distinct | sort
T6: sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | map ~({:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | coalesce null | if (eq null) ~(null) ~(/login))})
T7: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) | map ~(count)
T8: :p / | /dependencies | union (p | /devDependencies) | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/0) | map ~(:e / | /0 | keyword | append "@" | append (e | /1))
T9: /services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) | filter ~(/port | gt 8000) | map ~(/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: lines | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(/2) | map ~(count)
T11: lines | map ~(split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=")) | filter ~(count | gt 0) | map ~(/0 | drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
T12: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | filter ~(/5 | lower | eq "shipped") | map ~(mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum | round 2
T13: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | filter ~(/5 | lower | ne "cancelled") | groupBy ~(/1) | map ~(map ~(mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum | round 2) | entries | sort ~([(/1 | desc)]) | take 2 | map ~({:customer (/0 | keyword) :total /1})
